schemaVersion: "2.2"
  description: "Ag database details"
  parameters:
    InstanceName:
      type: "String"
      description: "sql server instance name"
    FileName:
      type: "String"
      description: "File name to dump tsql query output"
    GroupID:
      type: "String"
      description: "AAG group id"
    DatabaseGroupID:
      type: "String"
      description: "AAG database group id"
    Timeout:
      type: "String"
      description: "Timeout for the TSQL Query"
      allowedPattern: "[0-9]+"
    executionTimeout:
      type: "String"
      description: "Timeout for the SSM custom documents commands, default is set to 3600"
      default: "3600"
      allowedPattern: "[0-9]+"
  mainSteps:
    - action: aws:runPowerShellScript
      precondition:
        StringEquals:
          - platformType
          - Windows
      name: runCommands
      inputs:
        timeoutSeconds: "{{executionTimeout}}"
        runCommand:
          - "# Copyright (c) 2020 Clumio All Rights Reserved"
          - ""
          - "# Powershell script for fetching details to related a specific AG database"
          - ""
          - "# Get-StandaloneDBDetails fetches details realted to the AG standalone database,"
          - "# given group_database_id(database native id) and group_id(ag native id)"
          - "function Get-AGDBDetails"
          - "{"
          - "    param($InstanceName, $Filename, $GroupID, $DatabaseGroupID, $Timeout)"
          - ""
          - "    $Query = \"                        ;"
          - "                        WITH paginated_databases AS"
          - "                        ("
          - "                                 SELECT   d.name,"
          - "                                          d.compatibility_level,"
          - "                                          d.state,"
          - "                                          d.recovery_model,"
          - "                                          CONVERT(NVARCHAR, d.create_date, 127) AS create_date,"
          - "                                          d.database_id,"
          - "                                          d.group_database_id,"
          - "                                          CASE"
          - "                                                WHEN d.is_read_only = 1 Then 1"
          - "                                                ELSE 0"
          - "                                          END as 'is_read_only'"
          - "                                 FROM     sys.databases AS d"
          - "                                 WHERE    d.group_database_id = `$(database_group_id)"
          - "                                 ),"
          - "                         db_size AS"
          - "                        ("
          - "                                 SELECT   pd.database_id,"
          - "                                          CONVERT(varchar,sum(cast(mf.size as BIGINT))*8) AS database_size,"
          - "                                          CONVERT(varchar,sum(cast(mf.filestream_enabled as BIGINT))) AS filestream_enabled"
          - "                                 FROM     paginated_databases             AS pd"
          - "                                 JOIN"
          - "                                  ("
          - "                                            SELECT mfs.size as size,"
          - "                                                  mfs.database_id,"
          - "                                                  CASE"
          - "                                                      WHEN mfs.type = 2 Then 1"
          - "                                                      ELSE 0"
          - "                                                  END as 'filestream_enabled'"
          - "                                          from sys.master_files mfs"
          - "                                        ) as mf"
          - "                                 ON       pd.database_id=mf.database_id"
          - "                                 GROUP BY pd.database_id )"
          - "                        SELECT"
          - "                                  ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT 1)) AS table_index,"
          - "                                  CASE"
          - "                                            WHEN ags.primary_replica = Serverproperty('ServerName')  THEN 1"
          - "                                            ELSE 0"
          - "                                  END AS 'from_primary_replica',"
          - "                                  d.name,"
          - "                                  d.compatibility_level,"
          - "                                  d.state,"
          - "                                  d.recovery_model,"
          - "                                  d.create_date,"
          - "                                  d.database_id,"
          - "                                  db_size.database_size,"
          - "                                  serverproperty('productversion') AS instance_version,"
          - "                                  adc.group_database_id,"
          - "                                  adc.group_id,"
          - "                                  d.is_read_only,"
          - "                                  db_size.filestream_enabled,"
          - "                                  adc.synchronization_state"
          - "                        FROM      paginated_databases d"
          - "                        JOIN      db_size"
          - "                        ON        db_size.database_id = d.database_id"
          - "                        JOIN sys.dm_hadr_database_replica_states adc"
          - "                        ON        d.group_database_id = adc.group_database_id"
          - "                        LEFT JOIN sys.dm_hadr_availability_group_states ags"
          - "                        ON        ags.group_id = adc.group_id"
          - "           where adc.is_local = 1 and adc.group_id = `$(group_id);\""
          - "    try"
          - "    {"
          - "        $databaseVars = @("
          - "        \"group_id='$GroupID'\","
          - "        \"database_group_id='$DatabaseGroupID'\""
          - "        )"
          - "        $result = Invoke-Sqlcmd -ServerInstance $InstanceName -Query $Query -ErrorAction Stop -Variable $databaseVars -QueryTimeout $Timeout"
          - "        $result | Export-Csv -NoTypeInformation -Path $Filename -Append -Encoding UTF8"
          - "    }"
          - "    catch"
          - "    {"
          - "        Write-Error  $_.Exception.Message"
          - "    }"
          - "    return"
          - "}"
          - ""
          - "$InstanceName = \"{{InstanceName}}\""
          - "$Filename = \"{{FileName}}\""
          - "$GroupID = \"{{GroupID}}\""
          - "$DatabaseGroupID = \"{{DatabaseGroupID}}\""
          - "$Timeout = {{Timeout}}"
          - ""
          - "# calling into Get-AGDBDetails function to get specific AG database details"
          - "Get-AGDBDetails $InstanceName $Filename $GroupID $DatabaseGroupID $Timeout"
          - "type \"$Filename\""
          - ""
          - "# example"
          - "# Get-AGDBDetails 'AG-S2017-4\\AGSQL' 'C:\\Program Files\\Clumio\\Edge Connector\\mssql\\inv\\check12.csv' '2d480a5c-43e9-dcab-a838-5fdc846c4eef' 'f18c04b0-9bc0-421a-835c-30367369e339'"
          - ""

          - ""
          - "# example"

schemaVersion: "2.2"
  description: "Change Install Path for Clumio Binaries"
  parameters:
    OldBinaryPath:
      type: "String"
      description: "Old executables installation path"
    NewBinaryPath:
      type: "String"
      description: "New executables installation path"
    OldTempPath:
      type: "String"
      description: "Old temporary data installation path"
    NewTempPath:
      type: "String"
      description: "New temporary data installation path"
    CJTrackerServiceName:
      type: "String"
      description: "Clumio CJTracker service name"
    executionTimeout:
      type: "String"
      description: "Timeout for the SSM custom documents commands, default is set to 3600"
      default: "3600"
      allowedPattern: "[0-9]+"
  mainSteps:
    - action: aws:runPowerShellScript
      precondition:
        StringEquals:
          - platformType
          - Windows
      name: runCommands
      inputs:
        timeoutSeconds: "{{executionTimeout}}"
        runCommand:
          - "# Copyright (c) 2023 Clumio All Rights Reserved"
          - ""
          - "# Powershell script for upgrading clumio binary and temp path"
          - ""
          - "function CopyFolder"
          - "{"
          - "    param ($old_path, $new_path)"
          - "    try"
          - "    {"
          - "        # if old and new path is exactly the same there is no point in coping the folder"
          - "        if ($old_path -eq $new_path)"
          - "        {"
          - "            return"
          - "        }"
          - ""
          - "        # test if new path needs to created or already present"
          - "        $new_path_exists = Test-Path $new_path"
          - "        if (!$new_path_exists)"
          - "        {"
          - "            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $new_path"
          - "        }"
          - ""
          - "        # copy all stuff except vss and logs folder, and also exclude any .bak file"
          - "        ROBOCOPY $old_path $new_path /XF '*.bak' /XD 'logs', 'vss' /S /E /NP /NC"
          - ""
          - "        # copy cvss.exe, This will only copy the cvss exe nothing else"
          - "        $old_cvss_path = $old_path + '\\mssql\\dp\\vss'"
          - "        $new_cvss_path = $new_path + '\\mssql\\dp\\vss'"
          - "        ROBOCOPY $old_cvss_path $new_cvss_path cvss.exe"
          - ""
          - "        # copy logs folder only, without any files in it"
          - "        $old_log_path = $old_path + '\\logs'"
          - "        $new_log_path = $new_path + '\\logs'"
          - "        ROBOCOPY $old_log_path $new_log_path /XF * /S /E /NP /NC"
          - "    }"
          - "    catch"
          - "    {"
          - "        Write-Error 'Failed to copy folder with error'"
          - "        Write-Error $_.Exception.Message"
          - "    }"
          - "}"
          - ""
          - "# ChangeInstallPaths changes the binary and temp path"
          - "# Below are the steps"
          - "# - Stop the CJ tracker service"
          - "# - copy binary and temp folders"
          - "# - update the env variables"
          - "# - start cj tracker service using new cjtracker binary"
          - "function ChangeInstallPaths"
          - "{"
          - "    param("
          - "        $old_binary_path,"
          - "        $new_binary_path,"
          - "        $old_temp_path,"
          - "        $new_temp_path,"
          - "        $cj_tracker_service_name"
          - "    )"
          - ""
          - "    # this try catch block stops the service"
          - "    try"
          - "    {"
          - "        # stop the service"
          - "        Stop-Service $cj_tracker_service_name -ErrorAction Stop"
          - "    }"
          - "    catch"
          - "    {"
          - "        Write-Error 'failed to stop the cj parser service'"
          - "        Write-Error $_.Exception.Message"
          - "        return"
          - "    }"
          - ""
          - "    # copy the folders"
          - "    try"
          - "    {"
          - "        # copy binary path in all cases except when old binary path is same as new bianry path"
          - "        if ($old_binary_path -ne $new_binary_path)"
          - "        {"
          - "            CopyFolder $old_binary_path $new_binary_path"
          - "        }"
          - ""
          - "        # copy temp path only if old and new binary paths are different from old and new temp paths"
          - "        if (!($old_binary_path -eq $old_temp_path -and"
          - "                $new_binary_path -eq $new_temp_path) -and"
          - "                ($old_temp_path -ne $new_temp_path))"
          - "        {"
          - "            CopyFolder $old_temp_path $new_temp_path"
          - "        }"
          - "    }"
          - "    catch"
          - "    {"
          - "        Write-Error 'failed to copy the folders'"
          - "        Write-Error $_.Exception.Message"
          - "        # start the service if we fail to copy the folder so that backups can function as"
          - "        # it is"
          - "        Start-Service $cj_tracker_service_name"
          - "        return"
          - "    }"
          - ""
          - "    # set env variables"
          - "    [System.Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('CLUMIO_INSTALL_DIR', $new_binary_path, 'Machine')"
          - "    [System.Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('CLUMIO_TEMP_DIR', $new_temp_path, 'Machine')"
          - ""
          - "    # update the env variable and start the service"
          - "    try"
          - "    {"
          - "        $cj_parser_path = $new_binary_path + '\\mssql\\dp\\cjtracker.exe'"
          - "        sc.exe config $cj_tracker_service_name binPath= $cj_parser_path"
          - ""
          - "        Start-Service $cj_tracker_service_name"
          - "        $serviceStatus = Get-Service -Name $cj_tracker_service_name"
          - "        if ($serviceStatus.Status -ne 'Running')"
          - "        {"
          - "            Write-Error $_.Exception.Message"
          - "            return"
          - "        }"
          - "        else"
          - "        {"
          - "            Write-host 'successfully started service $cj_tracker_service_name'"
          - "        }"
          - "    }"
          - "    catch"
          - "    {"
          - "        Write-Error 'unable to start the service $cj_tracker_service_name'"
          - "        Write-Error $_.Exception.Message"
          - "    }"
          - "}"
          - ""
          - "$old_binary_path = '{{OldBinaryPath}}'"
          - "$new_binary_path = '{{NewBinaryPath}}'"
          - "$old_temp_path = '{{OldTempPath}}'"
          - "$new_temp_path = '{{NewTempPath}}'"
          - "$cj_tracker_service_name = '{{CJTrackerServiceName}}'"
          - ""
          - "#$old_binary_path = 'C:\\Clumio\\mssqlnewtestpath'"
          - "#$new_binary_path = 'C:\\testnew'"
          - "#$old_temp_path = 'C:\\Clumio\\mssqlnewtestpath'"
          - "#$new_temp_path = 'C:\\testnew'"
          - "#$cj_tracker_service_name = 'ClumioCJTracker'"
          - ""
          - "ChangeInstallPaths $old_binary_path $new_binary_path $old_temp_path $new_temp_path $cj_tracker_service_name"
          - ""

schemaVersion: "2.2"
  description: "Copy encryption key to the windows host"
  parameters:
    AccessKeyID:
      type: "String"
      description: "Temporary access key id of the clumio aws arena account"
    SecretAccessKey:
      type: "String"
      description: "Temporary secret access key of the clumio aws arena account"
    SessionToken:
      type: "String"
      description: "Temporary session token of the clumio aws arena account"
    Region:
      type: "String"
      description: "region of aws of the clumio aws arena account"
    HostKeyFilePath:
      type: "String"
      description: "Path to save host key"

      type: "String"
      description: "S3 bucket to download host key"
    ArenaBucketKey:
      type: "String"
      description: "S3 key to download host key"

  mainSteps:

      precondition:
        StringEquals:
          - platformType
          - Windows
      name: runCommands
      inputs:
        timeoutSeconds: "{{executionTimeout}}"
        runCommand:
          - "# Copyright (c) 2021 Clumio All Rights Reserved"
          - "#"
          - "# Powershell script set aws environment variables"
          - ""
          - "# reading aws related vaiables in powershell"
          - "$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID = '{{AccessKeyID}}'"
          - "$AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY = '{{SecretAccessKey}}'"
          - "$AWS_SESSION_TOKEN = '{{SessionToken}}'"

          - "$Env:AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY = $AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"
          - "$Env:AWS_SESSION_TOKEN = $AWS_SESSION_TOKEN"

          - "    catch {"

          - "        Write-Error $_.Exception.Message"
          - "        return"
          - "    }"
          - "}"
          - ""
          - "# path for the file to be created"

          - "# arena bucket"
          - "$ArenaBucket = '{{ArenaBucket}}'"
          - "# Bucket key for hostkey"
          - "$ArenaBucketKey = '{{ArenaBucketKey}}'"
          - "#S3 Host key url"
          - "$S3HostKeyUrl = '{{S3HostKeyUrl}}'"
          - "# AWS PS Enabled Feature Flag"
          - "$AWSPSEnabled = '{{AWSPSEnabled}}'"
          - ""
          - "CopyHostKey $HostKeyFilePath $ArenaBucket $ArenaBucketKey $S3HostKeyUrl $AWSPSEnabled"
          - ""
          - "# Copyright (c) 2021 Clumio All Rights Reserved"
          - "#"
          - "# Powershell script to unset/remove aws env variables"
          - ""
          - "# unset/Remove the aws env variables"
          - "Remove-item Env:AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"
          - "Remove-item Env:AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"
          - "Remove-item Env:AWS_SESSION_TOKEN"

  parameters:

      type: "String"

      allowedPattern: "[0-9]+"
    Flags:
      type: "String"
      description: "Flags to invoke"

      type: "String"
      description: "Timeout for the SSM custom documents commands, default is set to 3600"
      default: "3600"
      allowedPattern: "[0-9]+"
  mainSteps:
    - action: aws:runPowerShellScript
      precondition:
        StringEquals:
          - platformType
          - Windows
      name: runCommands
      inputs:
        timeoutSeconds: "{{executionTimeout}}"
        runCommand:
          - "$binary_path = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Session Manager\\Environment' -name CLUMIO_INSTALL_DIR).CLUMIO_INSTALL_DIR"
          - ""
          - "Switch ({{BinaryOpID}})"
          - "{"
          - "    1 {"
          - "        $binary_suffix = \"\\hcm\\winhostutil\""
          - "    }"
          - "    2 {"
          - "        $binary_suffix = \"\\mssql\\dp\\uploader\""
          - "    }"
          - "    3 {"
          - "        $binary_suffix = \"\\mssql\\dp\\restoreagent\""
          - "    }"
          - "    4 {"
          - "        $binary_suffix = \"\\mssql\\dp\\dpmssqlcloudagent\""
          - "    }"
          - "}"
          - ""
          - "$binary_path = $binary_path + $binary_suffix"
          - "if (Test-Path $binary_path) {"
          - "    # resolve the path and update the bianry path"
          - "    $binary_path = Get-Item $binary_path | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Target"
          - "} else {"
          - "    # else add exe to binary path"
          - "    $binary_path += '.exe'"
          - "}"
          - ""
          - "$binary_path = '\"{0}\"' -f $binary_path"
          - ""
          - "# resolve the path and update the binary path"
          - "$cmd = '& '+ $binary_path + '{{Flags}}'"
          - "Invoke-Expression -Command $cmd"
          - ""

schemaVersion: "2.2"
  description: "get all sql services"
  parameters:
    FileName:
      type: "String"
      description: "file path tp dump output of the script"
    executionTimeout:
      type: "String"
      description: "Timeout for the SSM custom documents commands, default is set to 3600"
      default: "3600"
      allowedPattern: "[0-9]+"
  mainSteps:
    - action: aws:runPowerShellScript
      precondition:
        StringEquals:
          - platformType
          - Windows
      name: runCommands
      inputs:
        timeoutSeconds: "{{executionTimeout}}"
        runCommand:
          - "# Copyright (c) 2023 Clumio All Rights Reserved"
          - ""
          - "# Load-Module will load the $name module if it is not already loaded. Will return false, if there is error in"
          - "# loading the module. Else, return true."
          - "function Load-Module"
          - "{"
          - "    param ("
          - "        [parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $name"
          - "    )"
          - "    $retVal = $true"
          - "    if (!(Get-Module -Name $name))"
          - "    {"
          - "        $retVal = Get-Module -ListAvailable | where { $_.Name -eq $name }"
          - "        if ($retVal)"
          - "        {"
          - "            try"
          - "            {"
          - "                Import-Module $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue"
          - "            }"
          - "            catch"
          - "            {"
          - "                $retVal = $false"
          - "            }"
          - "        }"
          - "    }"
          - "    return $retVal"
          - "}"
          - ""
          - "# GetClusterDetails returns cluster name and id for given sql service."
          - "# If the sql service is not clustered, it returns empty strings."
          - "# It uses `Get-ClusterResource` command to list all the clustered SQL instances and then find name and id."
          - "function GetClusterDetails {"
          - "    param ("
          - "        [parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $serviceName"
          - "    )"
          - "    $clusterName = \"\""
          - "    $clusterId = \"\""
          - "    # Get-ClusterResource will not work if FailoverClusters module is not loaded"
          - "    if (Load-Module \"FailoverClusters\")"
          - "    {"
          - "        try {"
          - "            $get_cluster_resource = Get-ClusterResource -ErrorAction Stop  -WarningAction silentlyContinue"
          - "        }"
          - "        catch {"
          - "            return $clusterName, $clusterId"
          - "        }"
          - "        try"
          - "        {"
          - "            # Check if the current service is default service or not"
          - "            if ($serviceName -eq \"MSSQLSERVER\")"
          - "            {"
          - "                # Get clusterResource for given SQL Server instance"
          - "                $clusterResource = ($get_cluster_resource | Where-Object {$_.Name -eq \"SQL Server\"})"
          - "            }"
          - "            else {"
          - "                # The INSTANCE_NAME part is extracted from the service name"
          - "                # The serviceName is of the format MSSQL$INSTANCE_NAME, in order to fetch the"
          - "                # instance name, service Name is split with respect to $"
          - "                $instance_name = $serviceName.Split('$')[1]"
          - "                # Get clusterResource for given SQL Server instance"
          - "                $clusterResource = ($get_cluster_resource | Where-Object {$_.Name -eq \"SQL Server ($instance_name)\"})"
          - "            }"
          - ""
          - "            # If clusterResource is empty, it means the current sql service is not clustered."
          - "            if ($clusterResource -ne $null)"
          - "            {"
          - "                $requiredGroup = $clusterResource.OwnerGroup"
          - ""
          - "                # $requiredGroup stores ownerGroup of SQL Server resource for given SQL service. The cluster resource"
          - "                # for SQL Network Name for given SQL service will also have same ownerGroup. Use this to find the"
          - "                # corresponding SQL Network Name resource. We can get further info about cluster from that"
          - "                # SQL Network Name resource"
          - "                $clusterResource = ($get_cluster_resource | Where-Object { $_.ResourceType -eq \"Network Name\" -and $_.OwnerGroup -eq $requiredGroup })"
          - "                if ($clusterResource -ne $null){"
          - "                    $clusterName = ($clusterResource | Get-ClusterParameter -Name 'Name').Value"
          - "                    $clusterId = $clusterResource.ID"
          - "                }"
          - "            }"
          - "        }"
          - "        catch"
          - "        {"
          - "            Write-Error  $_.Exception.Message"
          - "        }"
          - "    }"
          - "    return $clusterName, $clusterId"
          - "}"
          - ""
          - ""
          - "# Powershell script for getting all services installed inside a host"
          - "# Note: Need to run content of fci_utils.ps1 file along with this file while running SSM command."
          - ""
          - "# List all SQL Server Services"
          - "$services = (Get-Service -DisplayName \"SQL Server (*\")"
          - ""
          - "$service_info = \"\""
          - "# global variable for introducing index field for each service"
          - "# which will be later used for S3 select queries"
          - "$service_count = 1"
          - ""
          - "$domainName = (Get-WmiObject -Class Win32_ComputerSystem).Domain"
          - ""
          - "# loop over every service and fetch information and dump it"
          - "foreach ($service in $services)"
          - "{"
          - "    $serviceStatue = $service.Status.value__"
          - "    $serviceStartType = $service.StartType.value__"
          - ""
          - "    $status = 1"
          - "    if ($serviceStatue -eq 4)"
          - "    {"
          - "        $status = 4"
          - "    }"
          - "    elseif (($serviceStatue -eq 7))"
          - "    {"
          - "        $status = 3"
          - "    }"
          - "    elseif (($serviceStatue -eq 1))"
          - "    {"
          - "        $status = 2"
          - "    }"
          - ""
          - "    if ($serviceStartType -eq 1 -or $serviceStartType -gt 5)"
          - "    {"
          - "        $serviceStartType = 0"
          - "    }"
          - ""
          - "    # Initially the SQL Instance is considered not to be part of Failover Cluster"
          - "    $isClustered = $false"
          - "    $clusterName = \"\""
          - "    $clusterId = \"\""
          - "    # Obtain the service name"
          - "    $serviceName = $service.ServiceName"
          - ""
          - "    # GetClusterDetails is defined in fci_utils.ps1. Need to include content of utils.ps1 for running this script."
          - "    $clusterName, $clusterId = GetClusterDetails $serviceName"
          - ""
          - "    if ($clusterName -ne \"\")"
          - "    {"
          - "        $isClustered = $true"
          - "    }"
          - ""
          - "    $service_info += @{"
          - "        status = $status"
          - "        name = $service.ServiceName"
          - "        start_type = $serviceStartType"
          - "        computer_name = $env:ComputerName"
          - "        index = $service_count"
          - "        is_clustered = $isClustered"
          - "        sql_cluster_name = $clusterName"
          - "        sql_cluster_id = $clusterId"
          - "        domain_name = $domainName"
          - "    } | ConvertTo-Json | Out-String"
          - ""
          - "    # increment the current index for each instance (mssql service)"
          - "    $service_count++"
          - "}"
          - "$FileName = \"{{FileName}}\""
          - ""
          - "# if there is no instance then service_info var will be empty string and"
          - "# write-S3Obj doesn't upload empty file, this will ensure that we upload a file and"
          - "# able to run s3 select query"
          - "if ($service_info -eq \"\") {"
          - "    $service_info = \"{}\""
          - "}"
          - ""
          - "$service_info | Out-File -FilePath $FileName -Encoding utf8"
          - ""

schemaVersion: "2.2"
  description: "Script to install clumio binaries on the host"
  parameters:
    S3BucketName:
      type: "String"
      description: "S3 bucket to download clumio zip"
    S3BucketKey:
      type: "String"
      description: "S3 key to download clumio zip"
    BinariesFilePath:
      type: "String"
      description: "The path for ec2 host binaries"
    EC2HostBinaryPath:
      type: "String"
      description: "Path to install executables"
    EC2HostTempPath:
      type: "String"
      description: "The temporary path for the ec2 host"
    EC2HostServiceName:
      type: "String"
      description: "The name of the service to be installed"
    EC2HostDisplayName:
      type: "String"
      description: "The display name of the service to be installed"
    EC2HostServiceDescription:
      type: "String"
      description: "The description of the service to be installed"
    EC2HostServicePath:
      type: "String"
      description: "Service installation path"
    EC2HostCreateDirIfNotExists:
      type: "String"
      description: "Flag to check for dir existence"
    EC2BinariesVersion:
      type: "String"
      description: "Version for the biaries to be installed"
    EC2VersionsFileName:
      type: "String"
      description: "Version file name"
    EC2ProgramDataDir:
      type: "String"
      description: "Directory to store version info"
    EC2BinariesZipCheckSum:
      type: "String"
      description: "EC2 Binaries Zip Checksum"
    S3ZipUrl:
      type: "String"
      description: "S3 Zip Url"
    AWSPSEnabled:
      type: "String"
      description: "Boolean flag to use AWS powershell module for download"
    executionTimeout:
      type: "String"
      description: "Timeout for the SSM custom documents commands, default is set to 3600"
      default: "3600"
      allowedPattern: "[0-9]+"
  mainSteps:
    - action: aws:runPowerShellScript
      precondition:
        StringEquals:
          - platformType
          - Windows
      name: runCommands
      inputs:
        timeoutSeconds: "{{executionTimeout}}"
        runCommand:
          - "# Copyright (c) 2023 Clumio All Rights Reserved"
          - ""
          - "# Creates exe path by appending version string at the end of executable name before"
          - "# .exe extension"
          - "function CreateExePath"
          - "{"
          - "    param($raw_exe_path, $version)"
          - "    return $raw_exe_path + '_' + $version + '.exe'"
          - "}"
          - ""
          - "# Powershell script for installing binaries on ec2 host"
          - "Function InstallEC2Binaries {"
          - "    Param ($S3BucketName, $S3BucketKey, $BinariesFilePath, $EC2HostBinaryPath,"
          - "        $EC2HostTempPath, $EC2HostServiceName, $EC2HostDisplayName, $EC2HostServiceDescription,"
          - "        $EC2HostServicePath,$EC2HostCreateDirIfNotExists, $EC2BinariesVersion, $EC2VersionsFileName,"
          - "        $EC2ProgramDataDir, $EC2BinariesZipCheckSum, $S3ZipUrl, $AWSPSEnabled)"
          - "    try {"
          - "        $BinaryPathExists = Test-Path $EC2HostBinaryPath"
          - "        if (!$BinaryPathExists -And ($EC2HostCreateDirIfNotExists -Eq \"false\")) {"
          - "            Write-host \"binary path does not exists on host $EC2HostBinaryPath\""
          - "            Write-Error $_.Exception.Message"
          - "            return"
          - "        }"
          - "        $TempPathExists = Test-Path $EC2HostTempPath"
          - "        if (!$TempPathExists -And ($EC2HostCreateDirIfNotExists -Eq \"false\")) {"
          - "            Write-host \"temporary path does not exists on host $EC2HostTempPath\""
          - "            Write-Error $_.Exception.Message"
          - "            return"
          - "        }"
          - ""
          - "        # check if installation folder already exists and if non-empty return error"
          - "        # directory structure should be consistent"
          - "        if ($BinaryPathExists) {"
          - "            $directoryInfo = Get-ChildItem $EC2HostBinaryPath | Measure-Object"
          - "            if ($directoryInfo.count -ne 0)"
          - "            {"
          - "                Write-host \"binary path is non-empty $EC2HostBinaryPath\""
          - "                Write-Error $_.Exception.Message"
          - "                return"
          - "            }"
          - "        }"
          - "        # check if temp folder already exists and if non-empty return error"
          - "        # since same binary folder directory structure is needed in temp folder"
          - "        if ($TempPathExists) {"
          - "            $directoryInfo = Get-ChildItem $EC2HostTempPath | Measure-Object"
          - "            if ($directoryInfo.count -ne 0)"
          - "            {"
          - "                Write-host \"temp path is non-empty $EC2HostTempPath\""
          - "                Write-Error $_.Exception.Message"
          - "                return"
          - "            }"
          - "        }"
          - ""
          - "        # check if cjparser service already exists"
          - "        $currService = Get-Service -Name $EC2HostServiceName -ErrorAction Ignore"
          - "        if ($currService.Length -gt 0) {"
          - "            #cjparser service already exists first remove it to install it again"
          - "            Stop-Service $EC2HostServiceName -ErrorAction Ignore"
          - "            # Add some delay to stop the running service before removing it"
          - "            Start-Sleep -Seconds 5"
          - "            $serviceStatus = Get-Service -Name $EC2HostServiceName"
          - "            if ($serviceStatus.Status -eq \"Running\") {"
          - "                Write-host \"unable to stop the existing service $EC2HostServiceName\""
          - "                Write-Error $_.Exception.Message"
          - "                return"
          - "            }"
          - "            Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Service -Filter \"Name='$EC2HostServiceName'\" | Remove-CimInstance"
          - "            Write-host \"removed existing service $EC2HostServiceName before installing it again\""
          - "            # Add some delay to remove the existing service from the host before adding it again"
          - "            Start-Sleep -Seconds 10"
          - "        }"
          - "        # Force powershell to use tls 1.2"
          - "        [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12"
          - "        [System.Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable(\"CLUMIO_INSTALL_DIR\", $EC2HostBinaryPath, 'Machine')"
          - "        [System.Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable(\"CLUMIO_TEMP_DIR\", $EC2HostTempPath, 'Machine')"
          - "        [System.Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable(\"CLUMIO_INSTALL_VERSION\", $EC2BinariesVersion, 'Machine')"
          - ""
          - "        if ($AWSPSEnabled -Eq \"true\") {"
          - "            Copy-S3Object -BucketName $S3BucketName -Key $S3BucketKey -File $BinariesFilePath"
          - "        } else {"
          - "            if (-Not $BinaryPathExists) {"
          - "                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $EC2HostBinaryPath"
          - "            }"
          - "            (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadFile($S3ZipUrl, $BinariesFilePath)"
          - "        }"
          - "        Write-host \"successfully downloaded file at $BinariesFilePath\""
          - ""
          - "        $DownloadZipSHACheckSum = Get-FileHash -Algorithm sha256 $BinariesFilePath"
          - "        if($DownloadZipSHACheckSum.Hash -ne  $EC2BinariesZipCheckSum) {"
          - "            Write-host \"checksum mismatched original file hash  $EC2BinariesZipCheckSum download file hash $DownloadZipSHACheckSum\""
          - "            Write-Error $_.Exception.Message"
          - "            return"
          - "        }"
          - "        $PSversion = $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major"
          - "        if ($PSversion -ge 5) {"
          - "            Microsoft.PowerShell.Archive\\Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $BinariesFilePath -DestinationPath $EC2HostBinaryPath"
          - "            Write-host \"successfully unzipped to $EC2HostBinaryPath\""
          - "        } else {"
          - "            [void](New-Item -Path $EC2HostBinaryPath -ItemType Directory -Force)"
          - "            $Shell = new-object -com Shell.Application"
          - "            $Shell.Namespace($EC2HostBinaryPath).copyhere($Shell.NameSpace($BinariesFilePath).Items(), 0x14)"
          - "            Write-host \"successfully unzipped to $EC2HostBinaryPath\""
          - "        }"
          - ""
          - "        # this is added so that after unzipping the file there is time to release"
          - "        # handle for other process."
          - "        Start-Sleep -Seconds 5"
          - ""
          - "        Remove-Item -Force $BinariesFilePath -ErrorAction Ignore"
          - "        Write-host \"deleted the zip file after unarchive $BinariesFilePath\""
          - ""
          - "        # remove . from the versions to append it as a suffix in the execuables"
          - "        $version_numer = $EC2BinariesVersion.Replace('.', '_')"
          - ""
          - "        # rename the exes"
          - "        Rename-Item -Path \"$EC2HostBinaryPath\\mssql\\dp\\dpmssqlcloudagent.exe\" -NewName (CreateExePath 'dpmssqlcloudagent' $version_numer)"
          - "        Rename-Item -Path \"$EC2HostBinaryPath\\mssql\\dp\\uploader.exe\" -NewName (CreateExePath 'uploader' $version_numer)"
          - "        Rename-Item -Path \"$EC2HostBinaryPath\\mssql\\dp\\restoreagent.exe\" -NewName (CreateExePath 'restoreagent' $version_numer)"
          - "        Rename-Item -Path \"$EC2HostBinaryPath\\hcm\\winhostutil.exe\" -NewName (CreateExePath 'winhostutil' $version_numer)"
          - "        Rename-Item -Path \"$EC2HostBinaryPath\\mssql\\dp\\vss\\cvss.exe\" -NewName (CreateExePath 'cvss' $version_numer)"
          - ""
          - "        # create symlinks"
          - "        New-Item -ItemType SymbolicLink -Path \"$EC2HostBinaryPath\\mssql\\dp\\dpmssqlcloudagent\" -Target (CreateExePath \"$EC2HostBinaryPath\\mssql\\dp\\dpmssqlcloudagent\" $version_numer) -Force -ErrorAction Stop"
          - "        New-Item -ItemType SymbolicLink -Path \"$EC2HostBinaryPath\\mssql\\dp\\uploader\" -Target (CreateExePath \"$EC2HostBinaryPath\\mssql\\dp\\uploader\" $version_numer)  -Force -ErrorAction Stop"
          - "        New-Item -ItemType SymbolicLink -Path \"$EC2HostBinaryPath\\mssql\\dp\\restoreagent\" -Target (CreateExePath \"$EC2HostBinaryPath\\mssql\\dp\\restoreagent\" $version_numer) -Force -ErrorAction Stop"
          - "        New-Item -ItemType SymbolicLink -Path \"$EC2HostBinaryPath\\hcm\\winhostutil\" -Target (CreateExePath \"$EC2HostBinaryPath\\hcm\\winhostutil\" $version_numer)  -Force -ErrorAction Stop"
          - "        New-Item -ItemType SymbolicLink -Path \"$EC2HostBinaryPath\\mssql\\dp\\vss\\cvss\" -Target (CreateExePath \"$EC2HostBinaryPath\\mssql\\dp\\vss\\cvss\" $version_numer) -Force -ErrorAction Stop"
          - ""
          - "        if ($EC2HostBinaryPath -ne  $EC2HostTempPath)"
          - "        {"
          - "            Copy-Item -Path  $EC2HostBinaryPath -Destination $EC2HostTempPath -Recurse -Container -Filter { PSIsContainer -eq $true }"
          - "            Write-host \"successfully created the directory structure in $EC2HostTempPath\""
          - "        }"
          - ""
          - "        new-service -Name $EC2HostServiceName -DisplayName $EC2HostDisplayName -Description $EC2HostServiceDescription -BinaryPathName $EC2HostServicePath -StartupType Automatic"
          - "        Write-host \"successfully registered service $EC2HostServiceName\""
          - ""
          - "        Start-Service $EC2HostServiceName"
          - "        $serviceStatus = Get-Service -Name $EC2HostServiceName"
          - "        if ($serviceStatus.Status -ne \"Running\") {"
          - "            Write-host \"unable to start the service $EC2HostServiceName\""
          - "            Write-Error $_.Exception.Message"
          - "            return"
          - "        } else {"
          - "            Write-host \"successfully started service $EC2HostServiceName\""
          - "        }"
          - ""
          - "        New-Item -Path \"$env:ProgramData\" -Name $EC2ProgramDataDir -ItemType \"directory\" -Force"
          - "        New-Item -Path \"$env:ProgramData\\$EC2ProgramDataDir\" -Name $EC2VersionsFileName -ItemType \"file\" -Value $EC2BinariesVersion -Force"
          - "        Write-Host \"successfully written the versions info $EC2BinariesVersion in versions directory $env:ProgramData\\$EC2ProgramDataDir\""
          - "    }"
          - "    catch {"
          - "        Write-host \"got error in installing ec2 binaries on host\""
          - "        Write-Error  $_.Exception.Message"
          - "        return"
          - "    }"
          - "    Write-host \"successfully installed binaries at $EC2HostBinaryPath\""
          - "}"
          - ""
          - "# reading object related variable"
          - "$S3BucketName = '{{S3BucketName}}'"
          - "$S3BucketKey = '{{S3BucketKey}}'"
          - "# BinariesFilePath is the path where s3 object will get downloaded"
          - "$BinariesFilePath = '{{BinariesFilePath}}'"
          - "# EC2HostBinaryPath is the path for ec2 host binaries"
          - "$EC2HostBinaryPath = '{{EC2HostBinaryPath}}'"
          - "# EC2HostTempPath is the temporary path for the ec2 host"
          - "$EC2HostTempPath = '{{EC2HostTempPath}}'"
          - "# EC2HostServiceName is the name of the service to be installed"
          - "$EC2HostServiceName = '{{EC2HostServiceName}}'"
          - "# EC2HostDisplayName is the display name of the service to be installed"
          - "$EC2HostDisplayName = '{{EC2HostDisplayName}}'"
          - "# EC2HostServiceDescription is the description of the service to be installed"
          - "$EC2HostServiceDescription = '{{EC2HostServiceDescription}}'"
          - "# EC2HostServicePath is the service installation path"
          - "$EC2HostServicePath = '{{EC2HostServicePath}}'"
          - "#Flag to check for dir existence"
          - "$EC2HostCreateDirIfNotExists = '{{EC2HostCreateDirIfNotExists}}'"
          - "#Version for the biaries to be installed"
          - "$EC2BinariesVersion = '{{EC2BinariesVersion}}'"
          - "#Version file name"
          - "$EC2VersionsFileName = '{{EC2VersionsFileName}}'"
          - "# Directory to store version info"
          - "$EC2ProgramDataDir = '{{EC2ProgramDataDir}}'"
          - "# EC2 Binaries Zip Checksum"
          - "$EC2BinariesZipCheckSum = '{{EC2BinariesZipCheckSum}}'"
          - "# S3 Zip Url"
          - "$S3ZipUrl = '{{S3ZipUrl}}'"
          - "# AWS PS Enabled Feature Flag"
          - "$AWSPSEnabled = {{$AWSPSEnabled}}"
          - ""
          - "InstallEC2Binaries $S3BucketName $S3BucketKey $BinariesFilePath $EC2HostBinaryPath $EC2HostTempPath $EC2HostServiceName $EC2HostDisplayName $EC2HostServiceDescription $EC2HostServicePath $EC2HostCreateDirIfNotExists $EC2BinariesVersion $EC2VersionsFileName $EC2ProgramDataDir $EC2BinariesZipCheckSum $S3ZipUrl $AWSPSEnabled"
          - ""

schemaVersion: "2.2"
  description: "Script to get mssql server instance data in CSV format"
  parameters:
    InstanceName:
      type: "String"
      description: "FCI sql server instance name"
    FilenamePrefix:
      type: "String"
      description: "File path prefix to dump output of the Files"
    Limit:
      type: "String"
      description: "Numbers of records to fetch in sys.database tables"
      default: "20"
      allowedPattern: "[0-9]+"
    Timeout:
      type: "String"
      description: "Timeout for running tSQL command"
      default: "180"
      allowedPattern: "[0-9]+"
    executionTimeout:
      type: "String"
      description: "Timeout for the SSM custom documents commands, default is set to 3600"
      default: "3600"
      allowedPattern: "[0-9]+"
  mainSteps:
    - action: aws:runPowerShellScript
      precondition:
        StringEquals:
          - platformType
          - Windows
      name: runCommands
      inputs:
        timeoutSeconds: "{{executionTimeout}}"
        runCommand:
          - "# Copyright (c) 2020 Clumio All Rights Reserved"
          - ""
          - "# Powershell script for doing inventory, for instance, using TSQL commands"
          - ""
          - "# style guid followed lightly"
          - "# https://github.com/PoshCode/PowerShellPracticeAndStyle/blob/master/Style-Guide/Code-Layout-and-Formatting.md"
          - ""
          - "# used http://www.dpriver.com/pp/sqlformat.htm for formatting TSQL commands"
          - ""
          - "# there are many enums which are being queried from SQL server using T-SQL like recovery_model, database_state.. etc.,"
          - "# all enum conversion is happening at computeDiff state at computeDiff step at invsrvmssql host sync workflow step"
          - ""
          - "# Invoke-SQLQuery invokes SQL query and returns the result; it is a generic wrapper that dumps query results to"
          - "# the specified file supports pagination ( with argument Ispaginated as 1) Dumps page by page in the same file."
          - "# Avoid count query, which is expensive on the SQL Server. Limit parameter is used for pagination; it limits the number"
          - "# of rows fetched in paginated query"
          - "function Invoke-SQLQuery"
          - "{"
          - "    param($InstanceName, $Query, $Filename, $Limit, $IsPaginated, $Timeout)"
          - "    if ($IsPaginated -eq 0)"
          - "    {"
          - "        # If Isapginated is 0, then run the query and dump its out-put in the file specified"
          - "        # using try and catch to catch the error"
          - "        try"
          - "        {"
          - "            $result = Invoke-Sqlcmd -ServerInstance $InstanceName -Query $Query -ErrorAction Stop -QueryTimeout $Timeout"
          - "            $result | Export-Csv -NoTypeInformation -Path $Filename -Append -Encoding UTF8"
          - "        }"
          - "        catch"
          - "        {"
          - "            Write-Error  $_.Exception.Message"
          - "        }"
          - "        return"
          - "    }"
          - "    $PageNo = 1"
          - "    do"
          - "    {"
          - "        # If paginated then, fetch result until we receive zero rows from the SQL server"
          - "        $Offset = ($PageNo - 1) * $Limit"

          - "        $PaginationParams = @("
          - "        \"Offset='$Offset'\","
          - "        \"limit='$Limit'\""
          - "        )"
          - "        try"
          - "        {"
          - "            $result = Invoke-Sqlcmd -ServerInstance $InstanceName -Query $Query -ErrorAction Stop -Variable $PaginationParams -QueryTimeout $Timeout"
          - "            $result | Export-Csv -NoTypeInformation -Path $Filename -Append -Encoding UTF8"
          - "        }"
          - "        catch"
          - "        {"
          - "            Write-Error  $_.Exception.Message"
          - "            return"
          - "        }"
          - "        # incrementing page number"
          - "        $PageNo += 1"
          - "    } while (@($result).count -gt 0)"

          - ""
          - "# Get-StandaloneDBs dumps stand alone database present inside the sql server, it fetches standalone database"
          - "# in paginated fashion"
          - "# name = name of the database"
          - "# compatibility_level = 150, 140, 130 according to the sql server verison"
          - "# state -> dictates database state, i.e. online offiline, restoring, returns int 1,2,3"
          - "# recovery_model -> dictates recovery model of the database, 1 -> SIMPLE recovery model, 2 -> BULK recovery model,"
          - "#  3 -> FULL recovery model"
          - "# database_id is the integer database id"
          - "# database_size is the database size, it is in KBs"
          - "# database_guid is the database guid of the database"
          - "# instance_version is the product version of the instance"
          - "function Get-StandaloneDBs"
          - "{"
          - "    param($InstanceName, $FilenamePrefix, $Limit, $Timeout)"
          - ""
          - "    # query to fetch standalone databases. First, it uses pagination to fetch a subset of the database,"
          - "    # then apply group by on sys.master_files on database_id to get the size of the database,"
          - "    # using above generated tables use apply join on database_recovery_status to get the database details"
          - "    $StandaloneDBQuery = \""
          - "                            ;"
          - "                            WITH paginated_databases AS"
          - "                            ("
          - "                                     SELECT   d.name,"
          - "                                              d.compatibility_level,"
          - "                                              d.state,"
          - "                                              d.recovery_model,"
          - "                                              CONVERT(NVARCHAR, d.create_date, 127) AS create_date,"
          - "                                              d.database_id,"
          - "                                              CASE"
          - "                                                    WHEN d.is_read_only = 1 Then 1"
          - "                                                    ELSE 0"
          - "                                              END as 'is_read_only',"
          - "                                              d.source_database_id"
          - "                                     FROM     sys.databases AS d"
          - "                                     where NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.availability_databases_cluster as adc"
          - "                                                WHERE"
          - "                                                adc.database_name = d.name)"
          - "                                     ORDER BY d.database_id"
          - "                                     OFFSET CONVERT(int, `$(offset) ) rows"
          - "                                     FETCH next CONVERT( int, `$(limit) ) rows only ), db_size AS"
          - "                            ("
          - "                                     SELECT   pd.database_id,"
          - "                                              CONVERT(varchar,sum(cast(mf.size as BIGINT))*8) AS database_size,"
          - "                                              CONVERT(varchar,sum(cast(mf.filestream_enabled as BIGINT))) AS filestream_enabled"
          - "                                     FROM     paginated_databases             AS pd"
          - "                                     JOIN"
          - "                                     ("
          - "                                         SELECT mfs.size as size,"
          - "                                                mfs.database_id,"
          - "                                                CASE"
          - "                                                    WHEN mfs.type = 2 Then 1"
          - "                                                    ELSE 0"
          - "                                                END as 'filestream_enabled'"
          - "                                        from sys.master_files mfs"
          - "                                     ) as mf"
          - "                                     ON       pd.database_id=mf.database_id"
          - "                                     GROUP BY pd.database_id"
          - "                            )"
          - "                            SELECT"
          - "                                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT 1)) + `$(offset) AS table_index,"
          - "                                   pd.name,"
          - "                                   pd.compatibility_level,"
          - "                                   pd.state,"
          - "                                   pd.recovery_model,"
          - "                                   pd.create_date,"
          - "                                   pd.database_id,"
          - "                                   drs.database_guid,"
          - "                                   db_size.database_size,"
          - "                                   serverproperty('productversion') AS instance_version,"
          - "                                   pd.is_read_only,"
          - "                                   db_size.filestream_enabled,"
          - "                                   pd.source_database_id"
          - "                            FROM   paginated_databases pd"
          - "                            JOIN   sys.database_recovery_status drs"
          - "                            ON     pd.database_id = drs.database_id"
          - "                            JOIN   db_size"
          - "                            ON     db_size.database_id = pd.database_id;"
          - "                        \""
          - "    # construct csv file name"
          - "    $FileName = $FilenamePrefix + '_standalone_database.csv'"
          - "    Invoke-SQLQuery $InstanceName $StandaloneDBQuery $FileName $Limit 1 $Timeout"
          - "}"
          - ""
          - "# Get-AGDatabase dumps AG database present inside the SQL server; it fetches AGDBs in a paginated fashion"
          - "# name = name of the database"
          - "# compatibility_level = 150, 140, 130 according to the SQL server version"
          - "# state -> dictates database state, i.e. online offline, restoring, returns int 1,2,3"
          - "# recovery_model -> dictates recovery model of the database"
          - "# database_id is the integer database id"
          - "# database_size is the database size; it is in KBs"
          - "# database_guid is the database guid of the database"
          - "# instance_version is the product version of the instance"
          - "# group_database_id is AG database guid which will serve as database guid"
          - "# group_id is the AG guid, which is the native id for the AG"
          - "function Get-AGDatabase"
          - "{"
          - "    param($InstanceName, $FilenamePrefix, $Limit, $Timeout)"
          - "    # query to fetch AG databases. First, it uses pagination to fetch a subset of the database, then applies group by"
          - "    # on sys.master_files on database_id to get the size of the database, using above generated tables,"
          - "    # apply left join on availability_databases_cluster and dm_hadr_availability_group_states tables to"
          - "    # get the AG database details"
          - "    $AGDatabaseQuery = \""
          - "                        ;"
          - "                        WITH paginated_databases AS"
          - "                        ("
          - "                                 SELECT   d.name,"
          - "                                          d.compatibility_level,"
          - "                                          d.state,"
          - "                                          d.recovery_model,"
          - "                                          CONVERT(NVARCHAR, d.create_date, 127) AS create_date,"
          - "                                          d.database_id,"
          - "                                          d.group_database_id,"
          - "                                          CASE"
          - "                                                WHEN d.is_read_only = 1 Then 1"
          - "                                                ELSE 0"
          - "                                          END as 'is_read_only'"
          - "                                 FROM     sys.databases AS d"
          - "                                 where EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.availability_databases_cluster as adc"
          - "                                                WHERE"
          - "                                                adc.database_name = d.name)"
          - "                                 ORDER BY d.database_id"
          - "                                 OFFSET CONVERT(int, `$(offset) ) rows"
          - "                                 FETCH next CONVERT( int, `$(limit) ) rows only ),"
          - "                         db_size AS"
          - "                        ("
          - "                                 SELECT   pd.database_id,"
          - "                                          CONVERT(varchar,sum(cast(mf.size as BIGINT))*8) AS database_size,"
          - "                                          CONVERT(varchar,sum(cast(mf.filestream_enabled as BIGINT))) AS filestream_enabled"
          - "                                 FROM     paginated_databases             AS pd"
          - "                                                                      JOIN"
          - "                                     ("
          - "                                         SELECT mfs.size as size,"
          - "                                                mfs.database_id,"
          - "                                                CASE"
          - "                                                    WHEN mfs.type = 2 Then 1"
          - "                                                    ELSE 0"
          - "                                                END as 'filestream_enabled'"
          - "                                        from sys.master_files mfs"
          - "                                     ) as mf"
          - "                                 ON       pd.database_id=mf.database_id"
          - "                                 GROUP BY pd.database_id )"
          - "                        SELECT"
          - "                                  ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT 1)) + `$(offset) AS table_index,"
          - "                                  CASE"
          - "                                            WHEN ags.primary_replica =Serverproperty('ServerName')  THEN 1"
          - "                                            ELSE 0"
          - "                                  END AS 'from_primary_replica',"
          - "                                  d.name,"
          - "                                  d.compatibility_level,"
          - "                                  d.state,"
          - "                                  d.recovery_model,"
          - "                                  d.create_date,"
          - "                                  d.database_id,"
          - "                                  db_size.database_size,"
          - "                                  serverproperty('productversion') AS instance_version,"
          - "                                  adc.group_database_id,"
          - "                                  adc.group_id,"
          - "                                  d.is_read_only,"
          - "                                  db_size.filestream_enabled,"
          - "                                  db_replica_state.synchronization_state"
          - "                        FROM      paginated_databases d"
          - "                        JOIN      db_size"
          - "                        ON        db_size.database_id = d.database_id"
          - "                        LEFT JOIN sys.availability_databases_cluster adc"
          - "                        ON        d.group_database_id = adc.group_database_id"
          - "                        LEFT JOIN sys.dm_hadr_availability_group_states ags"
          - "                        ON        ags.group_id = adc.group_id"
          - "                        LEFT JOIN sys.dm_hadr_database_replica_states db_replica_state"
          - "                        ON        d.group_database_id = db_replica_state.group_database_id"
          - "                        where db_replica_state.is_local = 1;"
          - "                        \""
          - "    # construct csv file name"
          - "    $FileName = $FilenamePrefix + '_a_g_database.csv'"
          - "    Invoke-SQLQuery $InstanceName $AGDatabaseQuery $FileName $Limit 1 $Timeout"
          - "}"
          - ""
          - "# Get-InstanceDetails fetches details related to the specific instance"
          - "# is_a_g_present -> tells if a ag is present inside sql server or not"
          - "# edition -> is the edition of the sql server (Enterprise Edition (64-bit))"
          - "# product_version -> is the product version of the sql server (14.0.1000.169)"
          - "# server_name -> is the server name of the sql instance(AG-S2017-4\\AGSQL)"
          - "# instance_name is instance name of the sql server(AGSQL)"
          - "# host_name is host name of the host(AG-S2017-4)"
          - "function Get-InstanceDetails"
          - "{"
          - "    param($InstanceName, $FilenamePrefix, $Timeout)"
          - "    # InstanceQuery query fetches is a ag present in the instance or not, edition(Enterprise Edition (64-bit)),"
          - "    # product version(14.0.1000.169) server_name(hostname\\instanceName i.e., AG-S2017-4\\AGSQL),"
          - "    # instance name(i.e., AGSQL) and hostName(i.e., AG-S2017-4)"
          - "    # We have an enum IsAGPresent defined in that 1 means ag is not present, and 2 is AG is present"
          - "    $InstanceQuery = \""
          - "                    SELECT 1 AS table_index,"
          - "                           CASE"
          - "                             WHEN EXISTS("
          - "                                         SELECT 1"
          - "                                         FROM   sys.availability_groups) THEN 1"
          - "                             ELSE 2"
          - "                           END                                           AS 'is_a_g_present',"
          - "                           Serverproperty('Edition')                     AS edition,"
          - "                           Serverproperty('ProductVersion')              AS product_version,"
          - "                           Serverproperty('ServerName')                  AS server_name,"
          - "                           Serverproperty('InstanceName')                AS instance_name,"
          - "                           Serverproperty('ComputerNamePhysicalNetBIOS') AS host_name;"
          - "                    \""
          - "    # construct csv file name"
          - "    $FileName = $FilenamePrefix + '_instance_details.csv'"
          - "    Invoke-SQLQuery $InstanceName $InstanceQuery $FileName 0 0 $Timeout"
          - "}"
          - ""
          - "# Get-AGDetails fetches AG details related to the AG,"
          - "# table_index is the row index"
          - "# from_primary_replica is this entry coming from AG primary replica or not"
          - "# primary_replica is the primary replica name(which is the server name of the SQL instance)"
          - "# replica_id is the replica id of the replica"
          - "# replica_server_name replica server name"
          - "# failover_mode failover mode of the replica"
          - "# synchronization_state is the sync state of the replica(sync state, synchronizing state)"
          - "# availability_mode is the commit mode of the replica (sync commit, async commit)"
          - "# name is the name of the AG"
          - "function Get-AGDetails"
          - "{"
          - "    param($InstanceName, $FilenamePrefix, $Timeout)"
          - "    # AGQuery query fetches details related to the AG. Currently, it is non-paginated because the left joins"
          - "    # even if we paginate, we will gaining much as the max number should not be more than 10"
          - "    $AGQuery = \""
          - "                SELECT"
          - "                           ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT 1)) AS table_index,"
          - "                           CASE"
          - "                                      WHEN ags.primary_replica = Serverproperty('ServerName')  THEN 1"
          - "                                      ELSE 0"
          - "                           END AS 'from_primary_replica',"
          - "                           ags.primary_replica,"
          - "                           ar.replica_id,"
          - "                           ag.group_id,"
          - "                           ar.replica_server_name,"
          - "                           ar.failover_mode,"
          - "                           '' as synchronization_state,"
          - "                           ag.name,"
          - "                           ar.availability_mode"
          - "                FROM       sys.availability_groups   AS ag"
          - "                INNER JOIN sys.availability_replicas AS ar"
          - "                ON         ag.group_id = ar.group_id"
          - "                LEFT JOIN  sys.dm_hadr_availability_group_states AS ags"
          - "                ON         ag.group_id = ags.group_id"
          - "                \""
          - ""
          - "    $FileName = $FilenamePrefix + '_a_g_details.csv'"
          - "    Invoke-SQLQuery $InstanceName $AGQuery $FileName 0 0 $Timeout"
          - "}"
          - ""
          - "# Get-FCINodes fetches FCI nodes,"
          - "# table_index is the row index"
          - "# node_name is name of a node in the SQL Server failover cluster instance"
          - "# status is status of the node in a SQL Server failover cluster instance:  0, 1, 2, 3, -1. More info can be"
          - "#   found here - https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/clusapi/nf-clusapi-getclusternodestate"
          - "# status_description is description  of the status of the SQL Server failover cluster node."
          - "# is_current_owner is set to 1 when this node is the current owner of the SQL Server failover cluster resource"
          - "function Get-FCINodes"
          - "{"
          - "    param($InstanceName, $FileNamePrefix, $Timeout)"
          - "    $FCINodeQuery = \""
          - "                SELECT"
          - "                           ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT 1)) AS table_index,"
          - "                           NodeName as node_name,"
          - "                           status,"
          - "                           status_description,"
          - "                           is_current_owner"
          - "                FROM       sys.dm_os_cluster_nodes;"
          - "    \""
          - "    $FileName = $FileNamePrefix + '_fci_nodes.csv'"
          - "    Invoke-SQLQuery $InstanceName  $FCINodeQuery $FileName 0 0 $Timeout"
          - "}"

          - ""
          - "# Load-Module will load the $name module if it is not already loaded. Will return false, if there is error in"
          - "# loading the module. Else, return true."
          - "function Load-Module"
          - "{"
          - "    param ("
          - "        [parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $name"
          - "    )"
          - "    $retVal = $true"
          - "    if (!(Get-Module -Name $name))"
          - "    {"

          - "        if ($retVal)"
          - "        {"

          - "            catch"

          - "    return $retVal"

          - ""
          - "# GetClusterDetails returns cluster name and id for given sql service."
          - "# If the sql service is not clustered, it returns empty strings."
          - "# It uses `Get-ClusterResource` command to list all the clustered SQL instances and then find name and id."
          - "function GetClusterDetails {"
          - "    param ("
          - "        [parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $serviceName"
          - "    )"
          - "    $clusterName = \"\""
          - "    $clusterId = \"\""
          - "    # Get-ClusterResource will not work if FailoverClusters module is not loaded"
          - "    if (Load-Module \"FailoverClusters\")"
          - "    {"
          - "        try {"
          - "            $get_cluster_resource = Get-ClusterResource -ErrorAction Stop  -WarningAction silentlyContinue"
          - "        }"
          - "        catch {"
          - "            return $clusterName, $clusterId"
          - "        }"
          - "        try"
          - "        {"
          - "            # Check if the current service is default service or not"
          - "            if ($serviceName -eq \"MSSQLSERVER\")"
          - "            {"
          - "                # Get clusterResource for given SQL Server instance"
          - "                $clusterResource = ($get_cluster_resource | Where-Object {$_.Name -eq \"SQL Server\"})"
          - "            }"
          - "            else {"
          - "                # The INSTANCE_NAME part is extracted from the service name"
          - "                # The serviceName is of the format MSSQL$INSTANCE_NAME, in order to fetch the"
          - "                # instance name, service Name is split with respect to $"
          - "                $instance_name = $serviceName.Split('$')[1]"
          - "                # Get clusterResource for given SQL Server instance"
          - "                $clusterResource = ($get_cluster_resource | Where-Object {$_.Name -eq \"SQL Server ($instance_name)\"})"
          - "            }"
          - ""
          - "            # If clusterResource is empty, it means the current sql service is not clustered."
          - "            if ($clusterResource -ne $null)"
          - "            {"
          - "                $requiredGroup = $clusterResource.OwnerGroup"
          - ""
          - "                # $requiredGroup stores ownerGroup of SQL Server resource for given SQL service. The cluster resource"
          - "                # for SQL Network Name for given SQL service will also have same ownerGroup. Use this to find the"
          - "                # corresponding SQL Network Name resource. We can get further info about cluster from that"
          - "                # SQL Network Name resource"
          - "                $clusterResource = ($get_cluster_resource | Where-Object { $_.ResourceType -eq \"Network Name\" -and $_.OwnerGroup -eq $requiredGroup })"
          - "                if ($clusterResource -ne $null){"
          - "                    $clusterName = ($clusterResource | Get-ClusterParameter -Name 'Name').Value"
          - "                    $clusterId = $clusterResource.ID"
          - "                }"
          - "            }"
          - "        }"
          - "        catch"
          - "        {"
          - "            Write-Error  $_.Exception.Message"
          - "        }"
          - "    }"
          - "    return $clusterName, $clusterId"
          - "}"

          - "# Copyright (c) 2021 Clumio All Rights Reserved"
          - "# Powershell script for getting all services installed inside a host"

          - "$service_info = @()"

          - "# check if any sql server is installed or not, if length is zero then no"
