          - "            status = \"SYSADMIN_NOT_PROVISIONED\""
          - "        } | ConvertTo-Json | Out-String"
          - "        $errorOuccered = $true"
          - "        write-Error  $_"
          - "        # throw is terminating command else write-Error is not"
          - "    }"
          - ""
          - "    # Then check if sql writer has sysadmin prev or not"
          - "    try"
          - "    {"
          - "        $result = Invoke-Sqlcmd -ServerInstance $serverName -Query $SqlWriterSYSAdminCheckQuery -ErrorAction Stop"
          - "        if ($result.perm -ne 1)"
          - "        {"
          - "            $service_info += @{"
          - "                name = $serverName"
          - "                status = \"SQL_WRITER_SYS_ADMIN_NOT_PROVISIONED\""
          - "            } | ConvertTo-Json | Out-String"
          - "            $errorOuccered = $true"
          - "            write-error \"sql writer doesn't have sys admin permission not given to $serverName\""
          - "        }"
          - "        else"
          - "        {"
          - "            $service_info += @{"
          - "                name = $serverName"
          - "                status = \"SQL_WRITER_SYS_ADMIN_PROVISIONED\""
          - "            } | ConvertTo-Json | Out-String"
          - "        }"
          - "    }"
          - "    catch"
          - "    {"
          - "        $errorOuccered = $true"
          - "        $service_info += @{"
          - "            name = $serverName"
          - "            status = \"SQL_WRITER_SYS_ADMIN_NOT_PROVISIONED\""
          - "        } | ConvertTo-Json | Out-String"
          - "        write-Error $_"
          - "    }"
          - "}"
          - ""
          - "# refs:"
          - "# https://powershellshocked.wordpress.com/2018/04/27/checking-the-state-of-vss-writers/"
          - "# https://social.technet.microsoft.com/Forums/en-US/349427e7-22ff-49ce-aa11-73d5b878c0ce/"
          - "# using-invokecommand-to-run-vssadmin-list-writers-on-several-servers-how-do-i-sort-the-results"
          - "# NOTE: this check is added in script but it is not function as this check usually takes"
          - "# time if writer is busy"
          - "# Check-VSSListSqlWriterPresent checks if sql writer is present or not if not present"
          - "# then throw error"
          - "function Check-VSSListSqlWriterPresent {"
          - "    $plaintext = vssadmin list writers"
          - "    $vsswriters = @()"
          - "    foreach ($line in $plaintext) {"
          - "        switch -regex ($line) {"
          - "            (\"^Writer name:\") {"
          - "                $vsswriters += $Obj"
          - "                Remove-Variable -name Obj -Force -ErrorAction 0"
          - ""
          - "                $Obj = New-Object System.Object"
          - "                $writername = ($line -split \": \")[1] -replace \"'\", \"Failed\""
          - "                $Obj | Add-Member -MemberType NoteProperty -Name \"WriterName\" -value $writername -Force"
          - "                Remove-Variable -Name writername -force -ErrorAction 0"
          - "                break;"
          - "            }"
          - "            (\"^   \") {"
          - "                $attrname = ($line -split \": \")[0] -Replace \"   \", \"Failed\""
          - "                $attrval = ($line -split \": \")[1] -replace \"'\", \"Failed\""
          - "                $Obj | Add-Member -MemberType NoteProperty -Name $attrname -value $attrval -Force"
          - "                Remove-Variable -Name attrname, attrval -Force -ErrorAction 0"
          - "                break;"
          - "            }"
          - "            default {"
          - "                Continue"
          - "            }"
          - "        }"
          - "    }"
          - "    $sqlWriterObj = $vsswriters | Where-Object WriterName -Contains 'SqlServerWriter'"
          - ""
          - "    if ($sqlWriterObj.Length -eq 0) {"
          - "        $service_info += @{"
          - "            name = 'SQL_VSS_LIST_WRITER'"
          - "            status = \"SQL_VSS_LIST_WRITER_NOT_FOUND\""
          - "        } | ConvertTo-Json | Out-String"
          - "        Write-Error \"sql writer not found\""
          - "    } else {"
          - "        $service_info += @{"
          - "            name = 'SQL_VSS_LIST_WRITER'"
          - "            status = \"SQL_VSS_LIST_WRITER_FOUND\""
          - "        } | ConvertTo-Json | Out-String"
          - "    }"
          - "}"
          - ""
          - "# CheckVssWriterService-Running checks if vss writer service is running or not, if not"
          - "# running then throw error"
          - "function CheckVssWriterServiceRunning {"
          - "    param([ref] $errorOuccered)"
          - "    try {"
          - "        $vssWriterService = (Get-Service -DisplayName \"SQL Server VSS Writer*\")"
          - "    }"
          - "    catch{"
          - "        $service_info += @{"
          - "            name = 'SQL_SERVER_VSS_WRITER_SERVICE'"
          - "            status = \"SQL_SERVER_VSS_WRITER_SERVICE_NOT_FOUND\""
          - "        } | ConvertTo-Json | Out-String"
          - "        $errorOuccered.Value = $true"
          - "        return $service_info"
          - "    }"
          - ""
          - "    #check for the length of the vssWriterService object, it should be one only"
          - "    if ($vssWriterService.Length -ne 1)"
          - "    {"
          - "        $service_info += @{"
          - "            name = 'SQL_SERVER_VSS_WRITER_SERVICE'"
          - "            status = \"SQL_SERVER_VSS_WRITER_SERVICE_NOT_FOUND\""
          - "        } | ConvertTo-Json | Out-String"
          - "        $errorOuccered.Value = $true"
          - "        Write-Error \"vss writer service not present\""
          - "        return $service_info"
          - "    }"
          - "    $service_info += @{"
          - "        name = 'SQL_SERVER_VSS_WRITER_SERVICE'"
          - "        status = \"SQL_SERVER_VSS_WRITER_SERVICE_FOUND\""
          - "    } | ConvertTo-Json | Out-String"
          - ""
          - ""
          - "    # checks running state of the vss service, 4 prepresent running state"
          - "    $serviceStatus = $vssWriterService.Status.value__"
          - "    if ($serviceStatus -ne 4)"
          - "    {"
          - "        $service_info += @{"
          - "            name = 'SQL_SERVER_VSS_WRITER_SERVICE'"
          - "            status = \"SQL_SERVER_VSS_WRITER_SERVICE_NOT_RUNNING\""
          - "        } | ConvertTo-Json | Out-String"
          - "        $errorOuccered.Value = $true"
          - "        Write-Error \"sql server vss writer service not running\""
          - "        return $service_info"
          - "    }"
          - "    $service_info += @{"
          - "        name = 'SQL_SERVER_VSS_WRITER_SERVICE'"
          - "        status = \"SQL_SERVER_VSS_WRITER_SERVICE_RUNNING\""
          - "    } | ConvertTo-Json | Out-String"
          - "    return $service_info"
          - "}"
          - ""
          - "# CheckVSSServicePresent checks if vss service is not present or not"
          - "function CheckVSSServicePresent"
          - "{"
          - "    param ([ref] $errorOuccered)"
          - "    # fetch vss shadow copy service"
          - "    try"
          - "    {"
          - "        $vssWriterService = (Get-Service -DisplayName \"Volume Shadow Copy*\")"
          - "    }"
          - "    catch"
          - "    {"
          - "        # if error out then update SQL_SERVER_VSS_SHADOW_SERVICE status as"
          - "        # SQL_SERVER_VSS_SHADOW_SERVICE_NOT_PRESENT"
          - "        $service_info += @{"
          - "            name = 'SQL_SERVER_VSS_SHADOW_SERVICE'"
          - "            status = \"SQL_SERVER_VSS_SHADOW_SERVICE_NOT_PRESENT\""
          - "        } | ConvertTo-Json | Out-String"
          - "        $errorOuccered.Value = $true"
          - "        Write-Error \"vss shadow service not present\""
          - "        return $service_info"
          - "    }"
          - ""
          - "    # check for length if length is zero then there is no shadow service to take"
          - "    # vss shadow copy"
          - "    if ($vssWriterService.Length -eq 0)"
          - "    {"
          - "        $service_info += @{"
          - "            name = 'SQL_SERVER_VSS_SHADOW_SERVICE'"
          - "            status = \"SQL_SERVER_VSS_SHADOW_SERVICE_NOT_PRESENT\""
          - "        } | ConvertTo-Json | Out-String"
          - "        $errorOuccered.Value = $true"
          - "        Write-Error \"vss shadow service not present\""
          - "        return $service_info"
          - "    }"
          - ""
          - "    $service_info += @{"
          - "        name = 'SQL_SERVER_VSS_SHADOW_SERVICE'"
          - "        status = \"SQL_SERVER_VSS_SHADOW_SERVICE_PRESENT\""
          - "    } | ConvertTo-Json | Out-String"
          - "    return $service_info"
          - "}"
          - ""
          - ""
          - "# Check-VSSListSqlWriterPresent takes a lot of time if writer is busy"
          - "# Check-VSSListSqlWriterPresent please don't un-comment requires sys admin prev"
          - "$service_info += CheckVssWriterServiceRunning ([ref] $errorOuccered)"
          - "$service_info += CheckVSSServicePresent ([ref] $errorOuccered)"
          - ""
          - "# If there is error at any place of code then print srvice into as error stirng else"
          - "# in output strint"
          - "if ($errorOuccered -eq $true) {"
          - "    Write-Error ($service_info | Out-String)"
          - "} else {"
          - "    # printout $service_info for debugging"
          - "    $service_info"
          - "}"
          - ""

schemaVersion: "2.2"
  description: "Normal Heartbeat HCMsrv"
  parameters:
    EC2VersionsFileName:
      type: "String"
      description: "Version file name"
    EC2HostServiceName:
      type: "String"
      description: "The name of the service to be installed"
    executionTimeout:
      type: "String"
      description: "Timeout for the SSM custom documents commands, default is set to 3600"
      default: "3600"
      allowedPattern: "[0-9]+"
  mainSteps:
    - action: aws:runPowerShellScript
      precondition:
        StringEquals:
          - platformType
          - Windows
      name: runCommands
      inputs:
        timeoutSeconds: "{{executionTimeout}}"
        runCommand:
          - "# Copyright (c) 2021 Clumio All Rights Reserved"
          - ""
          - "# Powershell script for normal heartbeat for an ec2 host"
          - "# The output of this file is parsed based on new line to get the current binaries version"
          - "# installed on the ec2 host. So any change in this file should also reflect in parsing logic"
          - "#>"
          - "Function NormalHBEC2Host {"
          - "    Param ($EC2VersionsFileName, $EC2HostServiceName)"
          - "    try"
          - "    {"
          - "        $versionFilePath = \"$env:ProgramData//clumio//$EC2VersionsFileName\""
          - "        $VersionPathExists = Test-Path $VersionFilePath"
          - "        if (!$VersionPathExists)"
          - "        {"
          - "            Write-host \"version file does not exists on host $VersionFilePath\""
          - "            Write-Error $_.Exception.Message"
          - "        }"
          - "        # Fetch the binaries version on the host"
          - "        $currVersion = Get-Content $versionFilePath"
          - "        Write-Host \"current binaries version is - $currVersion\""
          - "        $serviceStatus = Get-Service -Name $EC2HostServiceName"
          - "        # If CJ tracker service is not running, Try to restart the service. If we fail to restart"
          - "        # the service then return error"
          - "        if ($serviceStatus.Status -ne \"Running\") {"
          - "            # NOTE: Start-Service runs in a synchronous manner"
          - "            # https://stackoverflow.com/questions/34309023/does-restart-service-run-asynchronously"
          - "            Start-Service $EC2HostServiceName"
          - "            $serviceStatus = Get-Service -Name $EC2HostServiceName"
          - "            if ($serviceStatus.Status -ne \"Running\") {"
          - "                Write-host \"clumio services on ec2 host are not running $EC2HostServiceName\""
          - "                Write-Error $_.Exception.Message"
          - "            }"
          - "        }"
          - "        $hostName = $env:computername"
          - "        Write-host \"host name is - $hostName\""
          - "    }"
          - "    catch {"
          - "        Write-host \"got error in normal heartbeat on host\""
          - "        Write-Error  $_.Exception.Message"
          - "        return"
          - "    }"
          - "    Write-host \"normal HB completed successfully\""
          - "}"
          - ""
          - "# reading object related variable"
          - "# Version File Path"
          - "$EC2VersionsFileName = '{{EC2VersionsFileName}}'"
          - "# EC2 Host Service Name"
          - "$EC2HostServiceName = '{{EC2HostServiceName}}'"
          - ""
          - "NormalHBEC2Host $EC2VersionsFileName $EC2HostServiceName"
          - ""

schemaVersion: "2.2"
  description: "System Heartbeat HCMsrv"
  parameters:
    executionTimeout:
      type: "String"
      description: "Timeout for the SSM custom documents commands, default is set to 3600"
      default: "3600"
      allowedPattern: "[0-9]+"
  mainSteps:
    - action: aws:runPowerShellScript
      precondition:
        StringEquals:
          - platformType
          - Windows
      name: runCommands
      inputs:
        timeoutSeconds: "{{executionTimeout}}"
        runCommand:
          - "# Copyright (c) 2021 Clumio All Rights Reserved"
          - "# Powershell script for system heartbeat for an ec2 host"
          - "Function SystemHBEC2Host {"
          - "    Param()"
          - "    try"
          - "    {"
          - "        $diskStats = Get-WmiObject -Class Win32_LogicalDisk | Select-Object -Property DeviceID, VolumeName, @{ Label = 'FreeSpace (Gb)'; expression = { ($_.FreeSpace/1GB).ToString('F2') } }, @{ Label = 'Total (Gb)'; expression = { ($_.Size/1GB).ToString('F2') } }, @{ label = 'FreePercent'; expression = { [Math]::Round(($_.freespace / $_.size) * 100, 2) } }| ConvertTo-Json"
          - "        $processorInfo = Get-WmiObject  Win32_processor | Select-Object -Property Name, Family, NumberOfCores, NumberOfLogicalProcessors, MaxClockSpeed | ConvertTo-Json"
          - "        $networkInfo = Get-NetAdapter -Name * -Physical | Select-Object -Property \"Name\", \"InterfaceDescription\", \"InterfaceName\", \"ifIndex\", \"Status\", \"MacAddress\", \"LinkSpeed\" | ConvertTo-Json"
          - "        $osName =  (Get-WMIObject win32_operatingsystem).Caption | out-string"
          - "        $osName = $osName -replace \"`t|`n|`r\",\"\""
          - "        $osArch = (Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem).OSArchitecture | out-string"
          - "        $osArch =  $osArch -replace \"`t|`n|`r\",\"\""
          - "        $buildNum = (Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem).BuildNumber"
          - "        $osDetails = @\""
          - "{"
          - "    \"OsName\":\"$osName\","
          - "    \"OsVersion\":\"$osArch\","
          - "    \"OsBuild\": $buildNum"
          - "}"
          - "\"@"
          - "        $totalRam = (Get-CimInstance Win32_PhysicalMemory | Measure-Object -Property capacity -Sum).sum"
          - "        $freePhysicalMem = (Get-Ciminstance Win32_OperatingSystem).FreePhysicalMemory"
          - "        $systemDetails = @\""
          - "{"
          - " \"MemoryCapacity\": $totalRam,"
          - " \"MemoryUsed\": $freePhysicalMem,"
          - " \"DiskCapacity\": $diskStats,"
          - " \"ProcessorDetails\": $processorInfo,"
          - " \"NetworkDetails\": $networkInfo,"
          - " \"OsDetails\": $osDetails"
          - "}"
          - "\"@"
          - "        write-output $systemDetails"
          - "    }"
          - "    catch {"
          - "        Write-host \"got error in system heartbeat on host\""
          - "        Write-Error  $_.Exception.Message"
          - "        return"
          - "    }"
          - "}"
          - ""
          - "SystemHBEC2Host"
          - ""

schemaVersion: "2.2"
  description: "Script to upgrade clumio binaries"
  parameters:
    S3BucketName:
      type: "String"
      description: "S3 bucket to download clumio zip"
    S3BucketKey:
      type: "String"
      description: "S3 key to download clumio zip"
    BinariesFilePath:
      type: "String"
      description: "The path for ec2 host binaries"
    EC2HostBinaryPath:
      type: "String"
      description: "Path to install executables"
    EC2HostServiceName:
      type: "String"
      description: "The name of the service to be installed"
    EC2HostDisplayName:
      type: "String"
      description: "The display name of the service to be installed"
    EC2HostServiceDescription:
      type: "String"
      description: "The description of the service to be installed"
    EC2HostServicePath:
      type: "String"
      description: "Service installation path"
    EC2HostSrcFileDir:
      type: "String"
      description: "The current directory which needs to be upgraded"
    EC2HostDestinationFileDir:
      type: "String"
      description: "The directory from which the upgrade needs to happen"
    EC2BinariesVersion:
      type: "String"
      description: "Version for the biaries to be installed"
    EC2VersionsFileName:
      type: "String"
      description: "Version file name"
    EC2ProgramDataDir:
      type: "String"
      description: "Directory to store version info"
    EC2BinariesZipCheckSum:
      type: "String"
      description: "EC2 Binaries Zip Checksum"
    S3ZipUrl:
      type: "String"
      description: "S3 Zip Url"
    AWSPSEnabled:
      type: "String"
      description: "Boolean flag to use AWS powershell module for download"
    executionTimeout:
      type: "String"
      description: "Timeout for the SSM custom documents commands, default is set to 3600"
      default: "3600"
      allowedPattern: "[0-9]+"
  mainSteps:
    - action: aws:runPowerShellScript
      precondition:
        StringEquals:
          - platformType
          - Windows
      name: runCommands
      inputs:
        timeoutSeconds: "{{executionTimeout}}"
        runCommand:
          - "# Copyright (c) 2023 Clumio All Rights Reserved"
          - ""
          - "# created exe path, appends version string before the exe in the execuatble name"
          - "function CreateExePath"
          - "{"
          - "    param($raw_exe_path, $version)"
          - "    return $raw_exe_path + '_' + $version + '.exe'"
          - "}"
          - ""
          - "# DeleteOldExecutables deleted the old executable"
          - "# it doesn't delete exe which has current version suffix in it and"
          - "# also doesn't delete cjtracker service"
          - "function DeleteOldExecutables"
          - "{"
          - "    param($EC2HostBinaryPath, $version_numer)"
          - "    try"
          - "    {"
          - "        $paths = @("
          - "        \"$EC2HostBinaryPath\\mssql\\dp\","
          - "        \"$EC2HostBinaryPath\\mssql\\dp\\vss\","
          - "        \"$EC2HostBinaryPath\\hcm\""
          - "        )"
          - "        Get-ChildItem -Path $paths -Attributes !Directory | Where-Object { $_.name -like '*.exe' -and $_.Name -notlike \"*$version_numer*\" -and $_.Name -notlike \"*cjtracker*\" } | Remove-Item"
          - "    }"
          - "    catch"
          - "    {"
          - "        Write-Host \"failed to delete some old files\""
          - "        Write-Host $_.Exception.Message"
          - "    }"
          - "}"
          - ""
          - "# Powershell script for upgrading binaries on ec2 host"
          - "Function UpgradeEC2Binaries"
          - "{"
          - ""
          - "    Param ($S3BucketName, $S3BucketKey, $BinariesFilePath, $EC2HostBinaryPath,"
          - "        $EC2HostServiceName, $EC2HostDisplayName, $EC2HostServiceDescription,"
          - "        $EC2HostServicePath, $EC2HostSrcFileDir, $EC2HostDestinationFileDir,"
          - "        $EC2BinariesVersion, $EC2VersionsFileName, $EC2ProgramDataDir, $EC2BinariesZipCheckSum,"
          - "        $S3ZipUrl, $AWSPSEnabled)"
          - "    try"
          - "    {"
          - "        $version_numer = $EC2BinariesVersion.Replace('.', '_')"
          - "        $BinaryPathExists = Test-Path $EC2HostBinaryPath"
          - "        if (!$BinaryPathExists)"
          - "        {"
          - "            Write-host \"binary path does not exists on host $EC2HostBinaryPath\""
          - "            Write-Error $_.Exception.Message"
          - "            return"
          - "        }"
          - ""
          - "        # Force powershell to use tls 1.2"
          - "        [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12"
          - "        if ($AWSPSEnabled -Eq \"true\")"
          - "        {"
          - "            Copy-S3Object -BucketName $S3BucketName -Key $S3BucketKey -File $BinariesFilePath"
          - "        }"
          - "        else"
          - "        {"
          - "            (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadFile($S3ZipUrl, $BinariesFilePath)"
          - "        }"
          - "        Write-host \"successfully downloaded file at $BinariesFilePath\""
          - ""
          - "        # check if cjparser service already exists"
          - "        $currService = Get-Service -Name $EC2HostServiceName -ErrorAction Ignore"
          - "        if ($currService.Length -gt 0)"
          - "        {"
          - "            #cjparser service already exists first remove it to upgrade it"
          - "            Stop-Service $EC2HostServiceName -ErrorAction Ignore"
          - "            # Add some delay to stop the running service before removing it"
          - "            Start-Sleep -Seconds 5"
          - "            $serviceStatus = Get-Service -Name $EC2HostServiceName"
          - "            if ($serviceStatus.Status -eq \"Running\")"
          - "            {"
          - "                Write-host \"unable to stop the existing service $EC2HostServiceName\""
          - "                Write-Error $_.Exception.Message"
          - "                return"
          - "            }"
          - "            Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Service -Filter \"Name='$EC2HostServiceName'\" | Remove-CimInstance"
          - "            Write-host \"removed existing service $EC2HostServiceName before upgrading it\""
          - "            # Add some delay to remove the existing service from the host before adding it again"
          - "            Start-Sleep -Seconds 10"
          - "        }"
          - ""
          - "        $DownloadZipSHACheckSum = Get-FileHash -Algorithm sha256 $BinariesFilePath"
          - "        if ($DownloadZipSHACheckSum.Hash -ne $EC2BinariesZipCheckSum)"
          - "        {"
          - "            Write-host \"checksum mismatched original file hash  $EC2BinariesZipCheckSum download file hash $DownloadZipSHACheckSum\""
          - "            Write-Error $_.Exception.Message"
          - "            return"
          - "        }"
          - "        $unzipDir = $EC2HostSrcFileDir -replace \".{2}$\""
          - "        $PSversion = $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major"
          - "        if ($PSversion -ge 5)"
          - "        {"
          - "            Microsoft.PowerShell.Archive\\Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $BinariesFilePath -DestinationPath  $unzipDir"
          - "            Write-host \"successfully unzipped to $unzipDir\""
          - "        }"
          - "        else"
          - "        {"
          - "            [void](New-Item -Path $unzipDir -ItemType Directory -Force)"
          - "            $Shell = new-object -com Shell.Application"
          - "            $Shell.Namespace($unzipDir).copyhere($Shell.NameSpace($BinariesFilePath).Items(), 0x14)"
          - "            Write-host \"successfully unzipped to $unzipDir\""
          - "        }"
          - ""
          - "        Remove-Item $BinariesFilePath -Force -ErrorAction Ignore"
          - "        Write-host \"deleted the zip file after unarchive $BinariesFilePath\""
          - ""
          - "        # After unzip is done rename the exes and append the version as the suffix before"
          - "        # coping into the file target destination"
          - "        Rename-Item -Path \"$unzipDir\\mssql\\dp\\dpmssqlcloudagent.exe\" -NewName (CreateExePath 'dpmssqlcloudagent' $version_numer)"
          - "        Rename-Item -Path \"$unzipDir\\mssql\\dp\\uploader.exe\" -NewName (CreateExePath 'uploader' $version_numer)"
          - "        Rename-Item -Path \"$unzipDir\\mssql\\dp\\restoreagent.exe\" -NewName (CreateExePath 'restoreagent' $version_numer)"
          - "        Rename-Item -Path \"$unzipDir\\hcm\\winhostutil.exe\" -NewName (CreateExePath 'winhostutil' $version_numer)"
          - "        Rename-Item -Path \"$unzipDir\\mssql\\dp\\vss\\cvss.exe\" -NewName (CreateExePath 'cvss' $version_numer)"
          - ""

          - "        Write-host \"Upgraded the binaries and scripts in folder $EC2HostDestinationFileDir\""
          - ""
          - "        Get-ChildItem -Path  $unzipDir -Recurse | Remove-Item -force -recurse"
          - "        Remove-Item $unzipDir -Force"
          - "        Write-host \"deleted the source directory after upgrade $unzipDir\""
          - ""
          - "        # create symlinks"
          - "        New-Item -ItemType SymbolicLink -Path \"$EC2HostBinaryPath\\mssql\\dp\\dpmssqlcloudagent\" -Target (CreateExePath \"$EC2HostBinaryPath\\mssql\\dp\\dpmssqlcloudagent\" $version_numer) -Force -ErrorAction Stop"
          - "        New-Item -ItemType SymbolicLink -Path \"$EC2HostBinaryPath\\mssql\\dp\\uploader\" -Target (CreateExePath \"$EC2HostBinaryPath\\mssql\\dp\\uploader\" $version_numer)  -Force -ErrorAction Stop"

          - ""
          - "        # update the env variable representing install version"

          - ""
          - "        new-service -Name $EC2HostServiceName -DisplayName $EC2HostDisplayName -Description $EC2HostServiceDescription -BinaryPathName $EC2HostServicePath -StartupType Automatic"

          - ""
          - "        Start-Service $EC2HostServiceName"
          - "        $serviceStatus = Get-Service -Name $EC2HostServiceName"
          - "        if ($serviceStatus.Status -ne \"Running\")"
          - "        {"
          - "            Write-host \"unable to start the service $EC2HostServiceName\""
          - "            Write-Error $_.Exception.Message"
          - "            return"
          - "        }"
          - "        else"
          - "        {"
          - "            Write-host \"successfully started service $EC2HostServiceName\""
          - "        }"
          - "        Set-Content -Path \"$env:ProgramData\\$EC2ProgramDataDir\\$EC2VersionsFileName\" -Value $EC2BinariesVersion -Force"
          - "        Write-Host \"successfully written the versions info $EC2BinariesVersion in versions directory $env:ProgramData\\$EC2ProgramDataDir\""

          - ""
          - "    }"

          - "    {"

clumio_iam_role_tags.description: Additional tags for Clumio IAM Roles.

clumio_inventory_sns_topic_encryption_ke.description: Optional existing KMS Key for the Clumio Inventory SNS topic. If one is provided, it MUST have a key policy similar to the one denoted in data.aws_iam_policy_document.clumio_event_pub_key_policy_document in [common.tf](https://github.com/clumio-code/terraform-clumio-aws-template/blob/main/common.tf).

clumio_pass_role_deny_list.description: List of IAM role ARNs that must be explicitly denied for iam:PassRole.

collect_inventory_aws_backup_recovery_po.description: Indicates whether AWS Backup (Recovery Point) data is collected for Discover. This data helps assess asset backup status more effectively.

create_clumio_inventory_sns_topic_encryp.description: Indicates that a KMS Key must be created and associated with the Clumio Inventory SNS topic.

data_plane_account_id.description: Allow only one role in clumio control plane to assume the ClumioIAMRole in customer's account.

iam_entities_identifier.description: Custom identifier used to label IAM entities (Roles and Managed Policies) created for the Clumio integration. Note that changing this value will trigger replacement of the associated IAM entities.

is_dynamodb_enabled.description: Flag to indicate if Clumio Protect for DynamoDB is enabled

is_ebs_enabled.description: Flag to indicate if Clumio Protect for EBS is enabled

is_ec2_mssql_enabled.description: Flag to indicate if Clumio Protect for Mssql on EC2 is enabled

is_iceberg_on_glue_enabled.description: Flag to indicate if Clumio Protect for Iceberg on Glue is enabled

is_iceberg_on_s3_tables_enabled.description: Flag to indicate if Clumio Protect for Iceberg on S3 Tables is enabled

is_rds_enabled.description: Flag to indicate if Clumio Protect for RDS is enabled. The IAM permissions granted by this flag are also used by Clumio Protect for DocumentDB and Neptune, since those services share the RDS API.

is_s3_enabled.description: Flag to indicate if Clumio Protect for S3 is enabled

path.description: Value of path set on the AWS IAM roles, policies and instance_profile resources of the module. If not specified the default value is /clumio/.

permissions_boundary_arn.description: ARN of the permissions boundary to be set on Clumio Roles.

role_external_id.description: A key that must be used by Clumio to assume the service role in your account. This should be a secure string, like a password, but it does not need to be remembered (random characters are best).

wait_for_data_plane_resources.description: Flag to indicate if we need to wait for data plane resources to be created.

wait_for_ingestion.description: Flag to indicate if we need to wait for ingestion to complete.

wait_time_before_create.description: Time in seconds to wait before creation of resources. This will be required to be set to a value above 45s in the case of shifting from old terraform template to the module based template.

connection.description: The clumio_aws_connection this IAM serves: the resource itself, or the preview's stand-ins.
